asset_description: Head (skull, face, ears, neck to the C7-level neck plane, neck capped) plus a short-hair shell cut from the scalp, as int16 multiples of quantum_head_lengths in the canonical head frame (x forward, y left, z up, neck plane at z=0, skin vertex at z=1 head length).
licence_text: This asset was explicitly released as CC0 in september 2020. The license text for CC0 can be found in the root of this repository. (header of makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj). LICENSE.md section C: 'The base mesh and proxies ... These assets have been released under CC0 1.0 Universal.' Section D: output/exports of MakeHuman carry no claim.
author: MakeHuman Team (copyright holders at the CC0 release: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier)
licence_pages_read: header comment of base.obj at the pinned commit
derivation: assets/head_cc0/build_head_asset.py (deterministic): head faces of group 'body' above joint-neck, neck capped, scalp faces above a hairline offset 3-7 mm as a closed hair shell, rescaled to one head length. The decimetre MakeHuman units are normalised away.
caveat: The community-assets-wip README says the base mesh 'as imported by makeclothes or maketarget remains AGPL'; this predates and is superseded by LICENSE.md section C and the explicit 2020-09 CC0 header in base.obj (the asset used here). Owner may wish to confirm.
